name: Light Dependent Resistor (LDR)
description: Like a pupil! Resistance drops dramatically when light hits it, allowing light level tracking.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a pupil! Resistance drops dramatically when light hits it, allowing light level tracking.
wiringGuidance: Connect one leg of LDR to 5V (Red). Connect the second leg to analog pin A0 (Yellow) and through a 10k resistor to GND (Dark Slate).
commonMistakes: Omitting the series 10k fixed resistor, creating a short circuit when exposed to bright light.

miniExperiment.title: Light & Shadow Theremin
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Outputs 600-900 in room light, falling below 150 when you cover the LDR with your palm.
